desc:
This lecture is part of the Raft User Study, an experiment to compare how students learn the Raft and Paxos consensus algorithms. It's a useful introduction for anyone learning Raft. Slides and voice-over by John Ousterhout.

Slides, more info, etc: https://raft.github.io/ and https://ramcloud.stanford.edu/~ongaro/userstudy/

Corresponding Paxos video: http://youtu.be/JEpsBg0AO6o
